title: Coupon
requirement: applyCoupon: SAVE5 subtracts 5.00, floor at 0; other codes unchanged.
task: Add a method `public BigDecimal applyCoupon(BigDecimal subtotal, String code)` to DiscountService. The code "SAVE5" subtracts 5.00 from the subtotal, but the result never goes below 0.00. Any other code (including null) returns the subtotal unchanged.
rationale: Explicit functional requirement with a floor.
